probability_support: Strict finite [0,1], without tolerance or clamp. Equality tolerances only apply to floating-point sums and identities.
tests: Enumerate ordered five-category microstates independently of the candidate count enumeration, N=1..4, tau={0,.37,1},nu={0,.61,1},m={0,.23,1},s={0,.41,1}, plus three interior/near-boundary fixtures.
Compare full joint conditional law of M,S given A,W with the multinomial splitting formula, not only conditional means.
Verify all observed marginals, covariance, conservation, reservoirs and the distribution of M+S conditional on the data.

Enumerate the literal kernel with four independent auxiliary counts at N=2; distinguish active and inactive priors, class normalization, global normalization and normalization conditional on all counts.
Check posterior class weighting uses observed likelihood rather than prior pi.
Check local observational equivalence without asserting equivalence after hierarchical integration.
Reproduce each preserved candidate script in a fresh QA directory with a 110-second process limit; record failures as failures and preserve logs.
decision_scope: Technical adequacy of the frozen proposal only; neither model adoption, inference, G3 PASS nor production approval.
